scanNote:
GRAMMAR 33-BET. Unit 7 — ko'plikka o'tkazish, vaqt predloglari va 1-7-unitlar takrori.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 9-mashq davomi (8 gap), 10-mashq (5 predlog), 11-mashq (12 ta xatoni tuzatish), 12-mashq (20 variant) — jami 45 ta javob.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — KO'PLIKKA O'TKAZGANDA UCh NARSA O'ZGARADI:
  ko'rsatish olmoshi: this → THESE, that → THOSE
  ot: pencil → pencilS, bus → busES
  fe'l: is → ARE, smells → SMELL, goes → GO
  ⚠ 4-band uchalasini ham ko'rsatadi: 'This flower SMELLS' → 'THESE flowerS SMELL'.

⚠ 10-MAShQ — ON yoki IN:
  ON — hafta kuni va aniq sana: on Sunday, on 19th May 1974, on Wednesday evenings
  IN — oy va kun qismi: in September, in the morning
  ⚠ 5-band nozik: 'ON Wednesday evenings' — hafta kuni bor, shuning uchun 'in the evening' emas, 'ON'.

⚠ 11-MAShQ — ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN XATOLAR TO'PLAMI:
  ega-fe'l mosligi: 'She often GO' → GOES; 'They VISITS' → VISIT; 'Paul CATCH' → CATCHES; 'I usually WRITES' → WRITE; 'we GOES' → GO
  have/has: 'Jane HAVE got' → HAS; 'My brother HAVEN'T' → HASN'T
  is/are: 'She ARE driving' → IS; 'These books ISN'T' → AREN'T
  zamon: 'Dolphins ARE LIVING for 50 years' → LIVE (doimiy holat); 'John WEARS ... TODAY' → IS WEARING
  ⚠ 4-band boshqacha: 'This house COST' → COSTS (uchinchi shaxs birlik).

⚠ 12-MAShQ 6 va 9-BAND — MODAL FE'LDAN KEYIN ASOSIY ShAKL: 'can't DANCE', 'can't FLY' — '-s' ham, '-ing' ham qo'shilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences with the underlined words in the plural, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tagiga chizilgan so'zlarni ko'plikka aylantirib, gaplarni qayta yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
32-betdagi 9-mashqning davomi (3–10 bandlar).

UCH NARSA O'ZGARADI:
  1) this → these,  that → those
  2) ot → ko'plik shakli
  3) fe'l → ko'plik shakli
       is    → are
       smells → smell   (3-shaxs -s TUSHADI)
       goes  → go

DIQQAT — TAGIGA CHIZILGAN QISM:
  Faqat tagiga chizilgan so'zlar o'zgaradi.
  Masalan: 'That pencil is Tracy's' — 'Tracy's' O'ZGARMAYDI,
  chunki u tagiga chizilmagan.

items.whyUz:
that → THOSE, pencil → PENCILS, is → ARE.
'Tracy's' o'zgarmaydi — u tagiga chizilmagan.

This → THESE, flower → FLOWERS, smells → SMELL.
Ega ko'plikka aylandi → 3-shaxs -S TUSHADI.
'to smell' = hidlanmoq; 'smell lovely' = yoqimli hid taratmoq.

that → THOSE, girl → GIRLS, is → ARE.
'Who' o'zgarmaydi.

items.textEn: 6  This shop is open until 5:30 pm.
items.answer: These shops are open until 5:30 pm.
items.whyUz:
This → THESE, shop → SHOPS, is → ARE.
'until' = ...gacha.

that → THOSE, car → CARS, is → ARE.
'expensive' = qimmat (sifat — o'zgarmaydi).

This → THESE, bus → BUSES (-s bilan tugagani uchun -ES),
goes → GO (3-shaxs -es TUSHADI).

that → THOSE, painting → PAINTINGS, is → ARE.
'a painting' = kartina, rasm; 'famous' = mashhur.

This → THESE, dog → DOGS, is → ARE.
'friendly' = do'stona (sifat — o'zgarmaydi).

exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT PREDLOGLARI — ON va IN

  ON — KUNLAR va SANALAR:
     on Sunday, on Monday morning,
     on 19th May, on my birthday,
     on Wednesday evenings (takrorlanadigan kunlar)

  IN — UZUNROQ DAVRLAR:
     in September (oylar)
     in 1974 (yillar)
     in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening
     in summer (fasllar)

  AT — ANIQ SOAT va istisnolar (bu mashqda yo'q):
     at 9 o'clock, at night, at the weekend

DIQQAT — CHALKASHTIRMANG:
  IN the morning     — umuman ertalab
  ON Monday morning  — aniq kunning ertalabi
  Kun aytilsa — ON g'olib chiqadi.

items.textEn: 1  Let's go to the cinema ............ Sunday.
items.whyUz:
Hafta kunlari oldida ON.
'Let's ...' = ...aylik (taklif).

Oy nomlari oldida IN.
'to start school' = o'qishni boshlamoq.

ANIQ SANA oldida ON: on 19th May.
DIQQAT: faqat yil bo'lsa IN bo'lardi: 'in 1974'.
Sana + oy bo'lsa — ON.
'to be born' = tug'ilmoq.

items.textEn: 4  Kevin goes to work ............ the morning.
items.whyUz:
'IN the morning/afternoon/evening' — umumiy kun qismi.
ISTISNO: 'AT night' (the yo'q, at bilan).

Hafta KUNI aytilgani uchun ON — 'in the evening' bo'lsa ham,
kun qo'shilsa ON g'olib chiqadi: ON Wednesday evenings.
Ko'plik ('evenings') — har chorshanba takrorlanishini bildiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Dolphins ARE LIVING for about fifty years.  →  live
     (chizib tashlangan so'z o'rniga to'g'ri shakl yoziladi)

ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN XATO TURLARI:

  1) 3-SHAXS -S yo'q yoki ortiqcha:
       She often GO → GOES
       They VISITS → VISIT

  2) NOTO'G'RI ZAMON:
       Dolphins ARE LIVING (doimiy fakt) → LIVE
       John WEARS ... today (bugun) → IS WEARING

  3) 'BE' yoki 'HAVE GOT' shakli mos emas:
       Jane HAVE got → HAS got
       She ARE driving → IS driving
       These books ISN'T → AREN'T
       My brother HAVEN'T got → HASN'T got

items.textEn: 1  Dolphins are living for about fifty years. → ............
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
Bu — DOIMIY FAKT, vaqtinchalik holat emas → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Dolphins' — ko'plik → LIVE (asos shakl).

items.textEn: 2  She often go to the beach on Sundays. → ............
items.whyUz:
'She' — birlik 3-shaxs → fe'lga -ES kerak: GOES.
'often' → Present Simple to'g'ri tanlangan.

'They' — ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI: VISIT.
-s faqat he/she/it uchun.

items.textEn: 4  This house cost £400 per month to rent. → ............
items.whyUz:
'This house' — birlik 3-shaxs → COSTS.
'to cost' = turmoq (narx); 'per month' = oyiga; 'to rent' = ijaraga olmoq.

items.textEn: 5  Every day, Paul catch the bus at 8 am. → ............
items.whyUz:
'Paul' — birlik 3-shaxs → CATCHES (-ch → -ES).
'Every day' → Present Simple.

items.textEn: 6  Jane have got red hair and blue eyes. → ............
items.whyUz: 'Jane' — birlik 3-shaxs → HAS got ('have got' XATO).

items.textEn: 7  I usually writes a letter to my friend every month. → ............
items.whyUz:
'I' bilan fe'l ASOS shaklida — -S QO'SHILMAYDI: WRITE.
-s faqat he/she/it uchun.

items.textEn: 8  She are driving to the beach now. → ............
items.whyUz:
'She' — birlik → IS driving ('are' XATO).
'now' → Present Continuous to'g'ri tanlangan.

items.textEn: 9  John wears black trousers and a T-shirt today. → ............
items.whyUz:
'today' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS kerak: IS WEARING.
'John wears ...' — odat bo'lardi, lekin 'today' hozirni bildiradi.
'trousers' = shim (doim ko'plikda).

items.textEn: 10  Every summer, we goes on holiday. → ............
items.whyUz:
'we' — ko'plik → GO ('goes' XATO).
'go ON holiday' — 'on' predlogi shart.

'These books' — ko'plik ega → AREN'T ('isn't' XATO).
'mine' = meniki (egalik olmoshi).

items.textEn: 12  My brother haven't got long hair. → ............
items.whyUz:
'My brother' — birlik 3-shaxs → HASN'T got ('haven't' XATO).
'hair' — sanalmaydigan ot, doim birlikda.

exercises.explanationUz:
20 ta test savoli — 1-7 unitlarning barcha mavzusi:
  ko'rsatish olmoshlari, Present Simple, Present Continuous,
  some/any, artikllar, so'roq so'zlari, predloglar,
  'can', 'have got', egalik olmoshlari.

Har bir savolga sabab keltirilgan.

items.whyUz:
'pencils' — KO'PLIK → ko'rsatish olmoshi ham ko'plikda: THOSE (yoki These).
'This' va 'That' — birlik uchun.

'He' — birlik 3-shaxs → DOESN'T.
'like' — oddiy fe'l, shuning uchun 'isn't' XATO.

'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE ('are having' XATO).
'We' — ko'plik → HAVE ('has' XATO).

items.textEn: 4  There aren't any ............ in the park.
items.whyUz:
'aren't any' — ko'plik talab qiladi → BENCHES (-ch → -ES).
'benches'' — egalik shakli, bu yerda kerak emas.

SAVOL gapda → ANY.
'some' tasdiq gapda ishlatiladi.
'a biscuit' = pechenye; 'left' = qolgan.
'can/can't' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — 'to', '-s', '-ing' YO'Q.

Otsiz ishlatilgani uchun EGALIK OLMOSHI kerak → MINE.
'your' va 'her' — egalik SIFATLARI, ular otdan oldin keladi
(your passport, her passport).

BUYRUQ gapning inkori DOIM 'DON'T' bilan —
ega yo'q, shuning uchun 'doesn't' XATO.
'can't' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida → FLY.

'have got' savoli: HAS + ega + GOT.
'Has James got ...?' — o'zgarmas qolip.

'Italian' UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → AN.
Kasb oldida artikl SHART: 'She's teacher' XATO.
'How + sifat' — o'lchov savoli: How TALL/BIG/OLD/LONG ...?

'some' — sanaladigan ot bilan KO'PLIK talab qiladi → DUCKS.
'ducks'' — egalik shakli, bu yerda kerak emas.

items.textEn: 14  The plane leaves Los Angeles ............ 9:00 am.
items.uz: Samolyot Los-Anjelesdan ertalab soat 9 da uchadi.
items.whyUz:
ANIQ SOAT oldida AT: at 9:00 am, at 5 o'clock.
'to leave' = jo'namoq, tark etmoq.

items.textEn: 15  ............ you like going to the cinema?
items.whyUz:
'you' + oddiy fe'l ('like') → DO.
'Are' XATO — 'like' fe'l, sifat emas.
'Does' faqat he/she/it uchun.

'is' + fe'l-ING = Present Continuous.
'at the moment' ham shuni tasdiqlaydi.

'is' + fe'l-ING → SHINING (-e TUSHDI).
'The sun shines' ham to'g'ri gap, lekin bu yerda 'is' bor.

EGALIK so'ralmoqda → WHOSE.
DIQQAT: 'Who's' = 'Who is' (kim) — boshqa ma'no,
lekin bir xil o'qiladi: /huːz/.

'... from?' — kelib chiqish JOYI so'ralmoqda → WHERE.
'Where are you from?' — o'zgarmas savol.

items.textEn: 20  There are ............ apple trees in the garden.
items.uz: Bog'da bir nechta olma daraxti bor.
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap + ko'plik → SOME.
'any' inkor va savolda; 'an' faqat birlikda.

wordFormation.introUz: 33-bet — vaqt predloglari va eng ko'p uchraydigan xatolar.

groups.explanationUz: Vaqt birligining aniqlik darajasiga qarab tanlanadi.
Sifat otdan OLDIN, olmosh esa OTSIZ ishlatiladi.

groups.ruleUz: 'can' va buyruq gapdan keyin ASOS shakl
groups.explanationUz: Bu holatlarda fe'lga hech narsa qo'shilmaydi.

patterns.formula: This/That + ot (birlik) + is  →  These/Those + otlar + are.
patterns.exampleEn: That car is expensive. → Those cars are expensive.
patterns.exampleUz: Anavi mashina qimmat. → Anavi mashinalar qimmat.
patterns.explanationUz: Uch narsa birga o'zgaradi: olmosh, ot va fe'l.

patterns.formula: AT + soat  /  ON + kun, sana  /  IN + oy, yil, kun qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: at 9:00 am, on Sunday, on 19th May, in September, in the morning
patterns.exampleUz: ertalab soat 9 da, yakshanba kuni, 19-may kuni, sentabrda, ertalab
patterns.explanationUz:
Vaqt birligi qanchalik aniq bo'lsa, predlog shunchalik 'kichik':
AT (soat) < ON (kun) < IN (oy, yil).

patterns.formula: Kun + kun qismi bo'lsa → ON g'olib chiqadi.
patterns.exampleEn: in the evening  →  ON Wednesday evenings
patterns.explanationUz: 'in the evening' — umumiy; kun qo'shilsa ON bo'ladi.
Ot bor bo'lsa — my/your/her. Ot yo'q bo'lsa — mine/yours/hers.
Buyruq gapda ega yo'q → 'doesn't' HECH QACHON ishlatilmaydi.
